shellCommands.command: ls -la && git ls-files && head -c 1500 package-lock.json; ls package.json 2>&1
cat package.json index.html src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls -R __agent_eval__ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -80; cat build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts; ls ../icons | head -5; cat ../../../__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -40; ls layout controls; sed -n 1,60p controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -30; ls Card; grep -n "errorMessage\|validationState\|errorPlacement" controls/types.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls icons | grep -E "^(ArrowUpFromLine|TrashBin|Person|CircleCheck)\.d\.ts"; grep -n "id?\|errorMessage\|validationState\|name?" uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head; grep -n "ControlProps" -A22 uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -40
ls . types; cat types/image.d.ts 2>/dev/null || cat AvatarImage/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || grep -rn "imgUrl\|imageUrl" --include=*.d.ts . | head
